seo.title: TempMail Pro | Corporate Communication Standardization
seo.description: Optimize your company's email writing. Reduce manual time by 40% with our template extension for Gmail and Outlook.

faqs.q: How does it integrate with Gmail and Outlook?
faqs.a: Our Chrome extension automatically detects draft fields using secure DOM manipulation, allowing you to inject templates with a single click.

faqs.q: Is it secure for corporate data?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We implement multi-tenant architecture with data isolation, JWT security, and in-transit encryption.

faqs.q: Can I customize templates for different teams?
faqs.a: Yes, the SaaS system allows creating folders by departments (Sales, Support, HR) with granular permissions.
